name: Simeon (Leah's son)
title: Jacob's second son and patriarch
summary: Simeon was Jacob's second son with Leah and became the ancestor of the tribe of Simeon in Israel. He is best known for joining his brother Levi in carrying out a revenge attack against Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped. His tribe was later absorbed into the tribe of Judah and did not receive its own contiguous territory.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Leah gave birth to her second son and named him Simeon, which means 'he has heard,' because the Lord had heard that she was unloved.

keyEvents.title: The Revenge on Shechem
keyEvents.description: After Shechem had raped their sister Dinah, Simeon and Levi deceived the men of Shechem and killed all the males in the city while they were weak from circumcision.

keyEvents.title: Held as a Hostage in Egypt
keyEvents.description: When the brothers came to Egypt to buy grain, Joseph held Simeon hostage until they returned with Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob cursed the fierce anger of Simeon and Levi and prophesied that they would be scattered in Israel, which was fulfilled when the tribe of Simeon was dispersed within the territory of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Simeon's Descendants Counted
keyEvents.description: At the census in the wilderness, Simeon's tribe was counted as 59,300 men fit for war, but by the second count they had decreased significantly.
